Tarn Rain Pant

A waterproof over-trouser with full-length side zips, so you can put it on over boots and crampons without sitting down in the wet. The zips are the whole point; a rain pant you have to take your boots off for stays in the pack.

Cut generously to go over a soft-shell. If you are between sizes take the smaller one, as the waist adjusts a long way.

180 USD.
